tests.firstFullRun: One boats-server test process exited without a detailed diagnostic while Chrome QA was running. All four boat tests passed alone; the final entire suite passed after Chrome closed.

checks: Two actual Chrome profiles share manual movement; title still has two entries and static credits
Save updates preserve menu selection; title exit and Start retain identity and supplies
Closing Chrome and the server process, then reopening both, restores both identities, equipment, inventory, plots, middens and shared food from disk
A real disk write failure is shown; the old checkpoint remains and a successful retry clears the error
Desktop, portrait and landscape menus remain usable; simulated Gamepad confirmation and focus survive save notifications
A damaged primary recovers its backup and the running UI explicitly discloses the recovery
fixtures: One planted root with a watering request, one resident carrying water, pantry and midden quantities, one resource amount
QA backup path obstructed for a real write failure; primary deliberately corrupted after shutdown
realActions: Separate server process restart and disk restore

notes: 111 saved profiles were checked sequentially; not 111 concurrent players
Year-long absence was a controlled clock test; no year-long wall-time run
Normal executable IPC shutdown and forced process termination use actual child processes
Private save contents and browser profiles stay outside Git
Initial new-test failures were fixture mistakes (mock runtime token/bufferedAmount and a request on an empty crop), corrected before final checks
